2610.13811.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
2610.13811.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
2610.13811.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在傳統代碼生成方面表現出色，並且越來越多地用於編寫保護這些代碼的單元測試。它們是否能在量子軟體上做到同樣的效果則不太明確，因為量子程式是隨機的，依賴於數值容差，並且由特定領域的檢查器進行評判，因此一個格式良好的測試仍然可能與基準的判決不一致。現有的量子基準測試衡量模型是否產生正確的解，但並不衡量其測試是否能區分正確的實現和錯誤的實現。我們介紹了QTestBench，一個評估LLM生成的量子測試套件的框架，該框架針對獨立的基準檢查器進行評估，從不將測試本身視為真實標準。對於每個任務，QTestBench提示模型生成語法、語義和行為測試，在運行時注入候選解，並在三個驗證群體下比較每個測試的判決與檢查器的標籤，每個群體回答一個不同的診斷問題。我們在八個PennyLane QHack挑戰和十個Qiskit HumanEval任務上對五個LLM進行基準測試。生成的套件幾乎總是可以執行，但區分能力落後：最佳生成器在QHack上的測試質量達到0.71，在Qiskit HumanEval上達到0.34，因此僅僅依賴可執行性會高估測試質量。當自然錯誤解決方案稀缺時，經過Oracle驗證的合成突變體穩定了錯誤檢測估算，這在十個Qiskit任務中的三個任務上沒有產生任何錯誤解決方案。QTestBench提供了一個可重現的、跨框架的基準，用於評估LLM生成的量子測試的可信度。
